messages.author: 8078800b7ede70d2
messages.subject: Geom_bar-error
parts:
I'm trying to produce geom_bar plot:

> d <- data.frame(UCBAdmissions)
> #THIS WORKS
> ggplot(d, aes(x = Gender, y = Freq)) + geom_point(aes(shape=Admit)) + facet_wrap(~Dept) + theme_bw()
> #THIS DOES NOT
> ggplot(d, aes(x = Gender, y = Freq)) + geom_bar() + facet_wrap(~Dept) + theme_bw()
Error in pmin(y, 0) : object 'y' not found
>

What would be the problem?

-J

messages.author: 8078800b7ede70d2
messages.subject: Re: Geom_bar-error
parts:
Ok, I think I got it. This seems to work:

> library(plyr)
> d1 <- ddply(d, c("Gender", "Dept"), numcolwise(sum))
> ggplot(d1, aes(x = Gender, y = Freq)) + geom_bar() + facet_wrap(~Dept) + theme_bw()
>

-J

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Geom_bar-error
parts:
By default, geom bar assumes that your data is unaggregated. There
are two ways to do what you want.

Supply weights:

ggplot(d, aes(x = Gender, weight = Freq)) +
